My Best Me. I LOVE how it doesn’t change me! It simply accentuates my best features and removes flaws that the i phone accentuates. For example, the wrinkles. The I phone camera lens ( the way it was designed with a curve, I think is what I read about) will zero in on any shadow and magnify it, and this is why the wrinkles look so much worse. Apparently they create a shadow that the iPhone picks up and enhances. The wrinkles are NOT something we want enhanced on our face lol, but if it’s a scenic photo it is great. It enhances little details that normally would not be noticeable. Retake simply undoes this enhancement so your photos look like what others see in person. It basically makes you look like the real you, not a version of you that focuses on and emphasizes tiny flaws like fine lines and uneven skin coloration like darker spots that are normally not noticeable to the eye when you’re in person. This way people see you how they would in person. It’s a natural fix and you don’t look like an entirely different person like other apps do. Every other app perfects the tiniest flaws and replaces them and you wind up with a different nose lips. Your nose will get replaced with one of their models nose. They change the Shape of your feathers and skin almost completely. Not Retake. If you want people to see YOU, this is the best app EVER!
